title: Notification regarding matters scheduled to be listed on 03-10-2026 shall be listed on 10-10-2026 & matters to be listed on 17-10-2026 shall be taken up on 31-10-2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
10.10.2026 and 31.10.2026 respectively shall be Court sitting days instead of first and
third Saturdays i.e., 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 respectively;
ii) first and third Saturdays i.e., 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 shall be holidays; and
iii) matters scheduled to be listed on 03.10.2026 shall be listed on 10.10.2026, and
matters scheduled to be listed on 17.10.2026 shall be taken up on 31.10.2026.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 25th September, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : in supersession of earlier order(s), if any in this
regard, it is informed to all learned members of the Bar and litigants as under:
i) only for the ensuing month of October, 2026, the second and fifth Saturdays i.e.,
10.10.2026 and 31.10.2026 respectively shall be Court sitting days instead of first and
third Saturdays i.e., 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 respectively;
ii) first and third Saturdays i.e., 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 shall be holidays; and
iii) matters scheduled to be listed on 03.10.2026 shall be listed on 10.10.2026, and
matters scheduled to be listed on 17.10.2026 shall be taken up on 31.10.2026.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/2Q88;( a)Or Imphal, the 25th September, 2026
